<b>Simple Keys</b> are [[Items (Silksong)#Keys|items]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They can be used to open simple locks. Each key can only be used once.

__TOC__
{{Clear}}

== Use ==
There are four locations where a Simple Key can be used:

{| class="article-table" width="100%" data-tpt-table-id="ss-simple-keys-uses"
! #
! Location
! Effect
! Map
|- data-tpt-row-id="key-use-bone-bottom"
! 1
| The lower entrance to the [[Wormways]] from [[Bone Bottom]].<ref><i>"An old stone gate with a simple keyhole."</i></ref>
| Access to the west side of the Wormways.
| [[File:Mapshot SS Simple Key Use Wormways.png|150x150px|center]]
|- data-tpt-row-id="key-use-deep-docks"
! 2
| Central [[Deep Docks]], to the south of [[Forge Daughter]].<ref><i>"A heavy door chained with a simple padlock."</i></ref>
| Access to the lower part of the Deep Docks without the [[Clawline]].<ref group="Note">The lower Docks can be opened from Far Fields and fully explored with Clawline without using a Simple Key.</ref>
| [[File:Mapshot SS Simple Key Use Deep Docks.png|150x150px|center]]
|- data-tpt-row-id="key-use-sinners-road"
! 3
| The [[Green Prince]]'s cell in [[Sinner's Road]]. <ref><i>"A cage with a simple lock."</i></ref>
| The Green Prince can be encountered in [[the Citadel]].<br>In [[Act 3]], access to [[Lost Verdania]].
| [[File:Mapshot SS Green Prince 01.png|150x150px|center]]
|- data-tpt-row-id="key-use-high-halls"
! 4
| [[High Halls]], west of the [[Ventrica Station]]. <ref><i>"An ornate door closed with a simple lock."</i></ref>
| Access to the [[High Halls#Rosary Bank|Rosary Bank]].
| [[File:Mapshot SS Simple Key Use High Halls.png|150x150px|center]]
|-
|}

== How to Acquire ==
There are four Simple Keys that can be obtained.

{| class="article-table" width="100%" data-tpt-table-id="ss-simple-keys-locations"
! #
! Location
! Map
|- data-tpt-row-id="key-bone-bottom" data-tpt-rowspan="2"
! rowspan="2" | 1
| Bought from [[Pebb]] in [[Bone Bottom]] for {{R|500}}. <ref>[[Pebb]]: <i>"Seems like just a key, but who knows what it'll unlock? I reckon it's come from the Citadel, so it must open the way to something holy!"</i></ref>
| [[File:Mapshot SS Pebb 01.png|150x150px|center]]
|- style="border-top: 0.1rem dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.5);"
| In [[Act 3]], bought from [[Grindle]] in [[Blasted Steps]] for {{R|600}}. <ref>[[Grindle]]: <i>"Us snitchbugs can wriggle into any place we want, but with this key even a big oafy bug like you can get through a locked door!"</i></ref>
| [[File:Mapshot SS Grindle 01.png|150x150px|center]]
|- data-tpt-row-id="key-sinners-road"
! 2
| At the northeast of [[Sinner's Road]], dropped by a [[Roachkeeper]] after defeating it.
| [[File:Mapshot SS Simple Key 02.png|150x150px|center]]
|- data-tpt-row-id="key-songclave"
! 3
| Bought from [[Jubilana]] in [[Songclave]] for {{R|650}}, after completing <i>[[The Wandering Merchant]]</i> [[Wish]]. <ref>[[Jubilana]]: <i>"Simply forged, and simply styled. Designed to open all sorts of different locks, if they be basic enough."</i></ref>
| [[File:Mapshot SS Jubilana 01.png|150x150px|center]]
|- data-tpt-row-id="key-sands-of-karak"
! 4
| Found on a corpse at the [[Bench (Silksong)|bench]] on the eastern tip of [[Sands of Karak]].
| [[File:Mapshot SS Simple Key 04.png|150x150px|center]]
|}
